paper_title: Towards a More Inclusive AI Progress and Perspectives in Large Language   Model Training for the Sámi Language
caption: The distribution of tokens and sentences across different domains in the SALT dataset is shown.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens across various categories within the SALT dataset. The horizontal axis displays categories including "Administrative," "Religion," "Non-fiction," "Fiction," "Law," "News," "Science," and "Blogs," presented in alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents token count, labeled "Tokens (k)," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10000 and tick labels at intervals of 2000.  There are eight bars, each a different color: orange, blue, purple, pink, light blue, teal, green, and gray. The bar representing "Administrative" has an approximate height corresponding to a value of 1889 tokens, while the bar for "Religion" reaches approximately 652 tokens. The bar representing "News" appears to be the tallest, with an approximate value of 6472 tokens, while the bar for “Blogs” is the shortest, with roughly 32 tokens. All the bars are regularly spaced and oriented vertically, with their labels positioned along the horizontal axis.
